candidates.change_summary: Change final returned literal from true to false so transfer returns false instead of true when the call completes.

Replace the call target selector to invoke transfer(address,address,uint256) (no From) so the external contract's function signature differs, changing which external function is executed and thus observable behavior.
Call uses transferFrom with reversed argument order (to, from) which will invoke a different external behavior when the callee depends on parameter positions.
Change the call to use delegatecall instead of call, altering the execution context and any state changes visible through external surface.
Remove the require check so calls proceed even when _tos is empty; this changes observable behavior when transfer is called with empty _tos.
Change revert() to continue on failure (remove revert and ignore failed call) so transfer returns true even if some external calls fail, altering observable outcome.
